Shared laws, commands and teaching applying to all within the stated audience or conditions. General does not remove covenant, historical, priestly or household limits. Read the existing Transformed, Fulfilled, Unchanged, Everlasting and other classifications alongside each entry.

Some source records still need their audience resolved. These are explicitly marked audience review pending; their provisional filing here is not a claim that they apply universally. Passage groups may contain both shared teaching and personal directions.

General · Personal · Instructions overview

3,869 study records in this view. Entries can overlap; this is not a count of distinct biblical commands. Ordered by the first source book, chapter and verse.

The source wording follows the Saints Greek-English text: the Septuagint for the Old Testament and the Greek New Testament. Headings and application notes are study summaries. Preserve the passage’s speaker, audience, conditions and grammatical form. Source alignment checked 6 November 2026; independent critical-Greek review remains in progress.

C0269 · Make and join the eleven hair curtains with the prescribed overlap, loops and clasps

Source wording · Saints Greek-English

26:7 You shall make hair curtains as a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

26:8 Each curtain shall be thirty cubits long and four cubits wide. The eleven curtains shall have the same measure.

26:9 You shall join five hair curtains by themselves and six by themselves, and double over the sixth curtain at the front of the tabernacle.

26:10 You shall make fifty loops along the edge of the middle hair curtain at the joining, and fifty along the edge of the curtain joining the second set.

26:11 You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and fasten the clasps into the loops, and join the hair curtains; and they shall be one.

26:12 You shall tuck under the surplus in the tabernacle’s hair curtains. You shall cover over the remaining half curtain; you shall cover over the surplus of the tabernacle’s hair curtains behind the tabernacle.

26:13 A cubit on this side and a cubit on that side, from the excess length of the tabernacle’s hair curtains, shall cover the tabernacle’s sides on either side.

Exodus 26:7–13

26:17 Each post shall have two tenons fitted opposite each other. You shall make all the tabernacle’s posts this way.

26:18 You shall make twenty posts for the tabernacle’s north side.

26:19 You shall make forty silver bases for the twenty posts, two bases for one post at its two parts, and two bases for another post at its two parts.

26:23 You shall make two posts for the corners at the rear of the tabernacle.

26:24 They shall be equal below, and likewise equal at their tops, at one joining. You shall make both this way for the two corners.

26:25 There shall be eight posts with sixteen silver bases, two for each post at its two parts, and two for each post.

C0277 · Make the bronze-covered altar with horns, grating and rings

Source wording · Saints Greek-English

27:1 “You shall make an altar of decay-resistant wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square and three cubits high.

27:2 You shall make horns on its four corners, of one piece with it, and cover them with bronze.

27:3 You shall make a rim for the altar, its cover, bowls, meat forks, and firepan. You shall make all its utensils of bronze.
